text_en: “A mortal, born of woman, few of days and full of trouble,
text_cn: 妇女所生的人，寿命不长，且饱尝烦恼。

text_en: comes up like a flower and withers, flees like a shadow and does not last.
text_cn: 他生出像花，瞬息凋谢；急驰如影，不得停留。

text_en: Do you fix your eyes on such a one? Do you bring me into judgment with you?
text_cn: 这样的人，岂配你睁眼注视一下？或传他到你面前听审？

text_en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? No one can.
text_cn: 谁能使洁净出于不洁？没有一人！

text_en: Since their days are determined, and the number of their months is known to you, and you have appointed the bounds that they cannot pass,
text_cn: 他的时日既已注定，他的岁数既由你掌管，他决不能越过你定下的期限：

text_en: look away from them, and desist, that they may enjoy, like laborers, their days.
text_cn: 请你别看他，让他安息，好像佣工度过自己的日期。

text_en: “For there is hope for a tree, if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, and that its shoots will not cease.
text_cn: 若是一棵树被砍伐了，仍有希望生出新芽，嫩枝丛出不穷。

text_en: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stump dies in the ground,
text_cn: 它的根虽老于地下，枝干纵枯死地上，

text_en: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put forth branches like a young plant.
text_cn: 但一有水气，立即生芽，好似幼苗发出枝叶。

text_en: But mortals die, and are laid low; humans expire, and where are they?
text_cn: 但是人一死，立即僵卧；人一断气，他究竟在何处？

text_en: As waters fail from a lake, and a river wastes away and dries up,
text_cn: 海水能干涸，江河能枯竭；

text_en: so mortals lie down and do not rise again; until the heavens are no more, they will not awake or be roused out of their sleep.
text_cn: 同样，人一僵卧，即不能起立，直到天不存在，仍不能醒起，仍不能由永眠中起来。

text_en: O that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would conceal me until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
text_cn: 唯愿你将我藏于阴府，将我隐藏，直到挽回你的愤怒；愿你给我定一期限，好记念我。

text_en: If mortals die, will they live again? All the days of my service I would wait until my release should come.
text_cn: 人若死了，岂能再生？我在整个从军之日，要坚持到底，直到换班的时期到来。

text_en: You would call, and I would answer you; you would long for the work of your hands.
text_cn: 你若呼唤我，我必回答你：你对你手所造的，必有一种怀念。

text_en: For then you would not number my steps, you would not keep watch over my sin;
text_cn: 你现今既数了我的脚步，不必再监察我的罪过。

text_en: my transgression would be sealed up in a bag, and you would cover over my iniquity.
text_cn: 请把我的罪过封闭在囊中，涤净我的一切过犯。

text_en: “But the mountain falls and crumbles away, and the rock is removed from its place;
text_cn: 但是，山能崩裂离析，磐石能由原处挪移，

text_en: the waters wear away the stones; the torrents wash away the soil of the earth; so you destroy the hope of mortals.
text_cn: 流水能穿过石头，骤雨能冲出泥沙：你也照样消灭了人的希望。

text_en: You prevail forever against them, and they pass away; you change their countenance, and send them away.
text_cn: 你时常攻击他，使他消逝；改变他的容貌，遣他离去。

text_en: Their children come to honor, and they do not know it; they are brought low, and it goes unnoticed.
text_cn: 此后，他的儿子受尊荣与否，他也不知；他们受轻贱与否，他也不觉。

text_en: They feel only the pain of their own bodies, and mourn only for themselves. ”
text_cn: 他只觉自己肉身的痛苦，他的心灵只为自己悲哀。
